instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Quantum is a bespoke custom furniture manufacturer specializing in solid wood pieces for the high-end hospitality and luxury residential markets. We leverage a hybrid production model, combining precision CNC routing with artisanal traditional joinery techniques to maintain quality while optimizing throughput.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources, demonstrating a commitment to scaling successful prototypes into revenue streams. Our current portfolio includes active projects spanning new material sourcing and the development of digital design tools.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible by diversifying service offerings.
answers.additionalContext: The primary competitive threat comes from large regional manufacturers who are rapidly automating low-complexity components and leveraging larger supply chains. Quantum's immediate challenge is maintaining quality perception while adapting to lean operational costs.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Service-as-a-Product (SaaP) Digital Module
opportunities.rationale: Given the owner's personal involvement and low budget, Quantum should explore radical shifting from selling physical goods to selling digital design/assembly services for high-end custom pieces. This lowers capital expenditure while increasing margin.

first_actions: Identify 3 core complex product lines suitable for modularization.
Develop a minimum viable 'Design Consultation' platform MVP.
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in non-product revenue stream by 15% within 9 months.
milestones: Q1: Define and prototype MVP scope.
Q2: Launch Beta service with 5 pilot clients.

opportunities.title: CNC Optimization & Material Substitution
opportunities.rationale: Focus on incremental operational improvements by investing the allocated budget into optimizing current CNC routines and testing sustainable, higher-margin wood composites that require less finishing time.

first_actions: Conduct a full process mapping audit to identify bottlenecks in joinery/routing.
Invest in simulation software for optimized material usage.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average project lead time by 10% and material waste by 5% within 6 months.
milestones: Month 3: Implement first batch of optimized routines.

opportunities.title: Targeted B2B Digital Presence (Self-Service)
opportunities.rationale: To combat churn, implement simple digital tools—like augmented reality configurators or detailed material spec libraries—to allow mid-tier customers to self-service basic customizations.

first_actions: Integrate a 3D visualization tool into the existing project intake form.
Create a centralized digital library of custom wood finishes and joinery options.
resources_needed: Dedicated owner time for content creation
execution_plan.success_metric: Decrease customer service inquiry volume by 20% in the first year.
milestones: Q3: Gather usage data and iterate.

next_steps.action: Initiate feasibility study for the Service-as-a-Product (SaaP) digital module.
Conduct a full operational bottleneck audit focusing on CNC routing efficiency.
Develop a simple customer-facing digital spec library for pilot testing.

key_weaknesses: Extreme reliance on the founder, limiting bandwidth and scaling potential.
High capital constraint (10% budget) severely restricts large-scale infrastructure investment.
Formal innovation process is hampered by owner-alone decision-making bottlenecks.
Low digital maturity limits ability to automate customer service or self-service sales.
